scope: Pre-execution amendment: same four synchronous markers with one reference-only sidechannel journal.
conditions: Only fresh private owned /tmp directory; journal created exclusively before native invocation.
Tiny helper writes marker to fd2 via fs.writeSync, then records marker/pid/returned byte count in the owned journal.
Full marker length must be distinguished from short write; no retry or catch suppression.
No direct test call, callback/assertion, registration semantics, native reporter, exit status or mandatory named-result criterion is changed.
No D1 preload/collector or custom reporter is introduced; helper is bounded four-marker instrumentation only.
Missing named native result stops negative/original comparisons regardless of sidechannel evidence.
interpretation_limits: Journal after returned write proves this marked reference code path reached that operation and worker fd2 accepted the recorded bytes.
Journal does not prove native parent receipt, stream retention, individual event emission or root cause.
Marker/body observations apply to the new diagnostic reference only, not original E1/D1/F2 callbacks.
